text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross vows to win the Takarazuka 
Kinen to give courage to her bedridden 
father. Standing in her way was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One, the spirited Tokyo-born 
Umamusume from Oi. A clash between East 
and West begins against a regional 
powerhouse quite unlike Oguri Cap.
